recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液中兩顆淋巴球的核呈多葉、邊緣深凹的花瓣樣（flower cell），染色質略粗、胞質淡藍無顆粒，是 ATLL 最具辨識度的核型態。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells with polylobated nuclei showing deep indentations (flower/cloverleaf shape)
Moderately condensed chromatin with an indistinct small nucleolus in one cell
Moderate rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Background red cells normochromic; a single platelet present
describe_en: High-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphocytes with moderate pale agranular cytoplasm and polylobated nuclei containing multiple deep indentations that produce a petal-like (flower cell) configuration. Chromatin is moderately condensed and nucleoli are inconspicuous. Findings are characteristic of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation with HTLV-1 serology and T-cell immunophenotyping (CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform grooves rather than discrete petal-shaped lobes and occur without HTLV-1 infection.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, rather than condensed chromatin with discrete lobes.
Hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections and are CD11c/CD25/CD103 positive B cells.
